cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: I’ve Done This Before
cards.instruction: Perform calm familiarity with the task while learning how it works from every new clue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I'll make your coffee. I know this machine: this button starts it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's steam. The coffee button is behind the flap.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Naturally. Steam first, then the concealed coffee controls. Where's your cup?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Here. It makes two cups unless you turn that dial.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Dial to one. I always tailor the standard procedure to the guest.
